physics: FRED 3.76 defaults: ionisation with straggling, MCS mode 6 (Rossi-Greisen + Fippel correction), nuclear elastic and inelastic interactions enabled; I(water) = 75 eV; DTmax 7 % energy step limiter; tracking cut at 50 um residual range (values as printed in the FRED smoke log)
source: 150 MeV proton pin beam at (0,0,-10 mm) along +z (1 cm vacuum gap), monoenergetic; N = 1 so dose is per primary
geometry: region Phantom 120 x 120 x 300 mm water, 60 x 60 x 150 voxels of 2 mm, entrance face at z = 0
units: native MHD headers; dose Gy/primary; LETd MeV cm2/g
rationale: Performance calibration reference (single CPU thread) for the proton-3d workload envelope and a first independent-MC proton depth-dose/LET reference in water; execution success is not physics validation
